risks.risk: CRS mismatch between uploaded optical raster and DEM
risks.evidence: RasterInput preserves CRS, while existing viewer localizes geometry and app has no DEM sidecar ingestion path
risks.mitigation: adapter requires CRS/transform equality after explicit DEM reprojection and records the common grid

risks.evidence: viewer uses local x/z dimensions from gsd and centers scene; Phase 89 uses projected 10 m pixels
risks.mitigation: derive all footprint and terrain positions from one affine transform and explicit local origin

risks.evidence: CalibrationResult can be metric or relative; viewer labels elevation/building height in meters
risks.mitigation: adapter rejects non-metric terrain/building inputs and carries units in provenance

risks.evidence: Phase 90 Himachal center crop had zero finite DEM; Phase 91 had to select a valid window
risks.mitigation: finite coverage gate, invalid-face omission, visible scene failure flag, no zero fill

risks.evidence: Phase 89 IDs are raster components; viewer expects local mesh coordinates
risks.mitigation: component-ID adapter emits both source pixel identity and projected/local polygon vertices

risks.evidence: viewer maps RGB with normalized UVs but does not carry raster transform in JavaScript
risks.mitigation: adapter validates same crop, shape, transform, and CRS before generating UVs

risks.evidence: viewer camera distance is based on local max_dim and existing presets
risks.mitigation: preserve existing framing but pass metric max_dim and unavailable-building metadata

risks.evidence: viewer generates terrain at stride 4; Phase 90 exported full 512x512 terrain meshes
risks.mitigation: keep viewer stride/downsampling configurable while retaining DEM provenance; do not send full raster unnecessarily

risks.evidence: Phase 89 has 2 unavailable Uttarakhand and 39 unavailable Himachal components
risks.mitigation: buildings list retains records with height_available=false; omit roof/wall geometry and show HEIGHT_UNAVAILABLE

risks.evidence: current app has no backend API; geometry is embedded as JSON in HTML
risks.mitigation: schema validation, strict finite-number checks, null handling, and explicit provenance before HTML generation

risks.risk: production path silently differs from Phase 89
risks.evidence: CalibrationEngine selects phase43 unet_config_D when present and build_city_geometry rebuilds evidence via watershed
risks.mitigation: adapter must be an explicit opt-in scene path; preserve current default and label source/checkpoint/threshold
